related_questions.question: What is the epidemiology of the pandemic?
related_questions.snippet: Epidemiology is the study of how often diseases occur in different groups of people and why. It applies this analysis to the control of diseases and other health problems. In the COVID-19 pandemic, it has been a vital area of research leading to swift, responsive action.

related_questions.snippet: Right now, COVID cases are still happening widely. In December 2023, the WHO reported 1.2 million COVID cases and 9,575 deaths worldwide.
